questions.question:
Consider the given statement(s) and decide which of the given assumption(s) is/are implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

The headmistress announced, “From now on every Wednesday there will be a storytelling session after Assembly”.

**Assumptions:**

I. Headmistress wants children to read stories.

II. Headmistress wants children to write their own stories.

options.text: Neither I nor II is implicit
Both I and II are implicit

questions.solution:
• According to the statement, a story-telling session has been made compulsory by the headmistress.
 
• A story-telling session is an activity of telling or writing stories.
 
• Thus, this can be safely assumed that the headmistress wants the children to read stories because the session is for "storytelling"
 
• Hence, the assumption I is implicit.
 
• Now, assumption II specifies that the children are asked to write "their own stories". Now the type of stories (whether their own stories or stories about someone else) to be written is not suggested in the statement.
 
• Hence, assumption II is not implicit.

Hence, “Only I is implicit”.

questions.question: What is the momentum of an object of mass (1)/(2)m and moving with a velocity of 2V?
questions.solution:
__**CONCEPT**__:

__
 
• **Momentum (p)**: The product of mass and velocity is called momentum. It is a vector quantity.

 
 
• The SI unit of momentum is kg m/s.
 
 

Momentum (p) = Mass (m') × Velocity (v')

**EXPLANATION**__:

Given that:

The mass of an object (m') is ½ m

The velocity (v') of an object is 2v

We know that momentum (p) = mass × velocity = ((m/2) × 2 v) = m v​

 
• **The momentum of the object is mv kg m/s**. Hence option 4 is correct.

questions.question: The ratio of the present ages of Naresh and Suparna is 7 ∶ 3. Three years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 2 ∶ 1. The current age of Naresh is ______ years.
questions.solution:
Let the present age of Naresh and Suparna be 7x and 3x.

⇒ Naresh’s age in three years = 7x + 3

⇒ Suparna’s age in three years = 3x + 3

According to question,

⇒ (7x + 3) ∶ (3x + 3) = 2 ∶ 1

⇒ 7x + 3 = 6x + 6

⇒ x = 3

⇒ Naresh’s present age = 7x = 7 × 3 = 21

questions.question: The surface area of three faces of a cuboid sharing a vertex are given as 25 m², 32 m² and 32 m². What is the volume of the cuboid?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The surface area of three faces = 25 m2, 32 m2 and 32 m2 

**Concept used:**

The surface area of one face

1.) Length × Breadth

2.) Breadth × Height

3.) Height × Length

Volume of cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

**Calculations:**

We have,

⇒ Length × Breadth = 25 m²

⇒ Breadth × Height = 32 m²

⇒ Height × Length = 32 m²

Multiplying the above three equations, we get,

⇒ (Length × Breadth × Height)² = 25 × 32 × 32

Taking square root on both sides,

⇒ (Length × breadth × Height) = 5 × 32

⇒ Length × breadth × Height = 160

⇒ Volume of cuboid = 160 m³ 

**∴ The volume of cuboid is 160 m³**

questions.question: Two times of a number, added to the square of that number, gives 3. What could be the possible answer for this number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2 × number + number² = 3

**Calculation:**

Let the number be x.

According to question,

⇒ 2x + x² = 3

⇒ x² + 2x – 3 = 0

⇒ x² – x + 3x – 3 = 0

⇒ (x – 1)(x + 3) = 0

⇒ x = 1, -3

questions.question: Travelling at a speed of 54 km/h, Chaman reaches a place 3 minutes early. If he had travelled at a speed of 48 km/h, he would have been 1 minute late. What is the distance Chaman had to travel?
questions.solution:
Let the actual time be t.

When Chaman reaches early,

⇒ Speed = 54 km/hr

⇒ Time = (t – 3) min = (t – 3)/60 hr

⇒ Distance = {(t – 3)/60} × 54 = {(9t – 27)/10} km

When Chaman reaches late,

⇒ Speed = 48 km/hr

⇒ Time = (t + 1) min = (t + 1)/60 hr

⇒ Distance = {(t + 1)/60} × 48 = {(8t + 8)/10} km

Now, we get,

⇒ {(9t – 27)/10} = {(8t + 8)/10}

⇒ t = 35 min

Now,

⇒ Distance = {(9t – 27)/10} = 288/10 = 28.8 km

questions.question: The diagonals of a rectangle are inclined to one side of the rectangle at 25°. The acute angle formed between the diagonals is:

⇒ ∠AOB + ∠OAB + ∠OBA = 180°

⇒ ∠AOB + 25° + 25° = 180°

⇒ ∠AOB = 130°

By linear pair property,

⇒ ∠DOA + ∠AOB = 180°

⇒ ∠DOA + 130° = 180°

⇒ ∠DOA = 50°

**∴ Both diagonals make 50° angle with each other.**ed

questions.question: Four numbers, when arranged in the ascending order are w, x, y, and z. The average of the smallest three numbers is 25.5 while the average of the largest three numbers was 29.5. What is the range of the data?
questions.solution:
Now,

⇒ (w + x + y)/3 = 25.5

⇒ w + x + y = 76.5 ----(1)

Also,

⇒ (x + y + z)/3 = 29.5

⇒ x + y + z = 88.5 ----(2)

Subtracting equation (1) from (2), we get,

⇒ z – w = 88.5 – 76.5 = 12

∴ The range of the data is 12.

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of two cousins is 54 years. Eleven years ago, the older one was thrice as old as the younger one. What is the present age of the older cousin?
questions.solution:
Let Present age of younger cousin and older cousin be a and b years respectively

⇒ a + b = 54 ----(1)

Also, 11 years ago,

⇒ (b – 11) = 3(a – 11)

⇒ b – 11 = 3a – 33

⇒ 3a – b = 22 ----(2)

Adding equation (1) and (2), we get

⇒ 4a = 76

⇒ a = 19

By equation (1), we have

⇒ 19 + b = 54

⇒ b = 35

∴ Present age of Older cousin is 35 years

 70% of the stores’ sales are from selling potato chips

average = Sum of elements/number of elements

questions.question: ______ is the formula for rust.
questions.solution:
• **Fe₂O₃ xH₂O** is the formula for rust.
 
• When iron is exposed to moist air, a reddish-brown coating of hydrated Iron (III) Oxide (Fe₂O₃) is deposited on its surface. This reddish-brown coating is called rust.
 
• Rust is an iron oxide, which occurs when iron or an alloy that contains iron, like steel, is exposed to oxygen and moisture for a long period of time.
 
• The chemical equation for the formation of rust is:
 
• Iron + Water + Oxygen = Rust. i.e. Ferric oxide with water as hydrated crystals in it.
 
• i.e. 4Fe(s) + 6H₂O(l) + 3O₂(g) → 4Fe(OH)₃(s).
 
• Therefore, the chemical formula for rust is Fe₂O₃.xH₂O.
 
• Here x indicates the number of moles of water absorbed by ferric oxide.

Both I and II are strong

questions.solution:
Argument I is strong because it gives a relevant fact about ‘recovering the green cover fast’ in its support. If the public joins in adopting and maintaining the trees on the roadside, the work would be faster.

Argument II is not as strong as it assumes that ‘public would not take responsibility’ without any factual basis

Hence, “Only argument I is strong”.

questions.question: Inclusive of a profit of 16% Rishi sold a pair of footwear for Rs. 2,059. What was the cost price of the pair of shoes?
questions.solution:
Let the cost Price be Rs. x

⇒ Profit % = {(Selling Price/Cost Price) – 1} × 100

⇒ 16 = {(2059/x) – 1} × 100

⇒ 0.16 = (2059/x) – 1

⇒ x = 1775

∴ The Cost Price is Rs. 1775
